## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (53%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs InSitu · Careful review
InSitu (34%) stays in the 90% conformal set on this simulated frozen section [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 53%, InSitu 34%, Normal 12%, Invasive 0% | Split between Benign and InSitu |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% target; test ECE 5%) | Cannot exclude InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 94th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Passes QC; high OOD percentile |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Models agree with each other |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Benign (4 Normal, 1 InSitu; 88%–90% similarity) [F5] | Zero Benign neighbor match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 4, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (-0.97), unreliable (0/20 AI spot-check) [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (-0.365; 20/20 AI spot-check) [F3] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical (+0.361; 12/20 AI spot-check) [F4] · Weak
- **Benign epithelial fraction** (regions 2, 7, 9) · context · 2% (4th percentile); few tumor nuclei, wrong validation direction [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops risk beyond random (95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable normal_lobules and mitoses (both 0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- An in situ lesion is present (34% probability, in conformal set, 1/5 neighbors InSitu).
- High OOD percentile (94%), 0/5 neighbor agreement, or simulated frozen-section artifacts distort scores.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 2, 7, 11**: Highest heatmap risk (up to 2%); confirm benign lobules and stroma.
2. **Regions 8, 9**: Inspect ducts for in situ atypia; consider drafted deeper levels order.
3. **Regions 1, 11, 8**: Verify clear surgical margins [F8], especially superior margin (93% score).
